exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct form of the adjectives.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVALDA HAR QATORDA BITTA yoki IKKI shakl
BERILGAN — qolganini topish kerak.

TO'LDIRILGAN JADVAL:

 ┌─────────────┬──────────────────┬─────────────────────┐
 │  ADJECTIVE  │   COMPARATIVE    │    SUPERLATIVE      │
 ├─────────────┼──────────────────┼─────────────────────┤
 │  expensive  │  MORE EXPENSIVE  │ the most expensive  │
 │  bad        │  worse           │ THE WORST           │
 │  OLD        │  older           │ the oldest          │
 │  SMALL      │  smaller         │ the smallest        │
 │  much/many  │  MORE            │ the most            │
 │  tiny       │  tinier          │ THE TINIEST         │
 │  high       │  HIGHER          │ the highest         │
 │  HOT        │  hotter          │ the hottest         │
 └─────────────┴──────────────────┴─────────────────────┘

(QALIN — kitob bergan shakl; qolganini siz
to'ldirasiz.)


HAR QATOR QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1-qator: 'more expensive' berilgan.
     'more' → uzun sifat → asosiy shakl
     EXPENSIVE, orttirmasi THE MOST EXPENSIVE.

  2-qator: 'the worst' berilgan.
     Bu — NOTO'G'RI sifat. Jadvaldan:
     bad → worse → the worst.

  3-qator: 'old' berilgan.
     Bir bo'g'inli → OLDER, THE OLDEST.

  4-qator: 'small' berilgan.
     Bir bo'g'inli → SMALLER, THE SMALLEST.

  5-qator: 'more' (yolg'iz) berilgan.
     'more' — NOTO'G'RI sifatning qiyosiy shakli:
     much/many → more → the most.
     DIQQAT: 1-qatorda ham 'more' bor, lekin u
     yerda 'more EXPENSIVE' — sifat bilan birga.
     Bu yerda 'more' YOLG'IZ turibdi → 'much/many'.

  6-qator: 'the tiniest' berilgan.
     '-iest' → '-y' bilan tugagan sifat:
     TINY → TINIER → the tiniest.
     'tiny' = juda kichkina.

  7-qator: 'higher' berilgan.
     '-er' → HIGH → THE HIGHEST.

  8-qator: 'hot' berilgan.
     Bir bo'g'inli, undosh+unli+undosh →
     't' IKKILANADI: HOTTER, THE HOTTEST.


DIQQAT — 5-QATORDAGI 'MORE' ALDAMChI:
  Yolg'iz turgan 'more' — 'much' yoki 'many' ning
  qiyosiy shakli.
  Agar 'more + sifat' bo'lsa (1-qatordagidek),
  u uzun sifatning qiyosiy shakli.

DIQQAT — 6 va 8-QATORLAR MAXSUS QOIDALAR:
  tiny → tinIER    ('-y' tushadi)
  hot  → hotTER    (undosh ikkilanadi)

items.whyUz:
'more expensive' berilgan →
asosiy shakl EXPENSIVE,
orttirma shakl THE MOST EXPENSIVE.
Uzun sifat (3 bo'g'in) → MORE / THE MOST.

'the worst' — NOTO'G'RI sifatning orttirma shakli.
Jadvaldan: BAD → WORSE → the worst.
'badder' yoki 'baddest' XATO.

Bir bo'g'inli → -ER / THE -EST.
old → OLDER → THE OLDEST.

Bir bo'g'inli → -ER / THE -EST.
small → SMALLER → THE SMALLEST.

'more' YOLG'IZ (sifatsiz) → bu NOTO'G'RI
sifatning qiyosiy shakli.
MUCH / MANY → more → THE MOST.
'much' — sanalmaydigan ot bilan (much water),
'many' — sanaladigan ot bilan (many books).
DIQQAT: 1-qatorda 'more EXPENSIVE' edi —
u yerda 'more' sifat bilan birga.

'-IEST' → '-y' bilan tugagan sifat.
TINY → TINIER → the tiniest.
'tiny' = juda kichkina ('small' dan ham kichik).

'-ER' → qisqa sifat.
HIGH → higher → THE HIGHEST.
'high' = baland (tog', devor uchun;
bino va odam uchun 'tall').

hot = h (undosh) + o (unli) + t (undosh)
→ 't' IKKILANADI.
HOT → HOTTER → THE HOTTEST.
'hoter' / 'hotest' XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with in, of, than, the or as ... as.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni in, of, than, the yoki as ... as bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh VARIANT: in, of, than, the, as ... as

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  longer THAN the Mississippi
  2  THE smallest country IN the world
  3  not AS clean AS Stratford
  4  the most comfortable OF all
  5  a famous club IN Los Angeles
  6  cheaper THAN living in the city
  7  the hottest place IN the world
  8  not AS noisy AS Paris


QANDAY ANIQLASh — UCh KALIT BELGI:

  Sifat QIYOSIY shaklda ('-er' yoki 'more ...')
     →  THAN
     (1, 6-bandlar)

  Sifat ORTTIRMA shaklda ('-est' yoki 'most ...')
     →  'THE' oldidan + 'OF' yoki 'IN' keyin
     OF + guruh ('of all', 'of the three')
     IN + joy  ('in the world', 'in town')
     (2, 4, 7-bandlar)

  Sifat ODDIY shaklda va 'not' bor
     →  AS ... AS
     (3, 8-bandlar)

  Oddiy joy ko'rsatish
     →  IN
     (5-band)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Amazonka daryosi Missisipidan uzunroq.
  2  Vatikan davlati dunyodagi eng kichik davlat.
  3  Nyu-York Stratford chalik toza emas.
  4  Mening shahrimda ko'p mehmonxona bor.
     'Chelsea' hammasidan eng qulayi.
  5  'The Whiskey' — Los-Anjelesdagi mashhur klub.
  6  Qishloqda yashash shaharda yashashdan arzonroq.
  7  O'lim vodiysi dunyodagi eng issiq joy.
  8  Oksford Parij chalik shovqinli emas.


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDA IKKI BO'ShLIQ:
  'is ...... smallest country ...... the world'
  Birinchisi — THE (orttirma daraja oldidan),
  ikkinchisi — IN (joy bilan).

DIQQAT — 4-BANDDA 'OF ALL':
  'the most comfortable OF ALL'
  'all' — GURUH → 'of'.
  'in all' XATO.

DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'LIVING':
  'LIVING in the country is cheaper THAN LIVING
   in the city.'
  Ikki tomonda ham '-ing' shakli — chunki
  bir xil narsalar solishtirilishi kerak.


BU MAShQDAGI ATOQLI OTLAR — TANIShI:
  the Amazon River, the Mississippi — daryolar
  the State of the Vatican City — Coursebook 85-bet,
     12-mashqning 5-bandidan
  Stratford, Los Angeles — Coursebook 82-87-betlardan
  The Whiskey — Coursebook 83-betdagi maqoladan
  Death Valley — Coursebook 85-bet, 12-mashqdan
  Oxford, Paris — shaharlar

items.sentence: 1  The Amazon River is longer ........ the Mississippi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'longER' — QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
Amazonka daryosi Missisipidan uzunroq.

items.sentence: 2  The State of the Vatican City is ........ smallest country ........ the world.  [1-bo'shliq]

commonMistake.whyUz:
'smallEST' — ORTTIRMA daraja →
oldidan DOIM 'THE'.
Grammar 52-betdagi Note qutisidan.

'the world' — JOY → IN.
ORTTIRMA daraja: OF + guruh, IN + joy.
Coursebook 85-bet, 12-mashqning 5-bandi ham
shu fakt haqida edi.

items.sentence: 3  New York is not ........ clean ........ Stratford.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'clean' — ODDIY shakl va 'not' bor →
AS ... AS.
'New York is NOT AS CLEAN AS Stratford'
= Nyu-York Stratford chalik toza emas
(ya'ni Stratford tozaroq).

items.sentence: 4  There are many hotels in my town. The Chelsea is the most comfortable ........ all.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'the most comfortable' — ORTTIRMA daraja,
va 'all' — GURUH → OF.
'of all' = hammasidan.
'in all' XATO.

items.sentence: 5  The Whiskey is a famous club ........ Los Angeles.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Oddiy JOY ko'rsatish → IN.
Bu bandda qiyoslash YO'Q.
'The Whiskey' — Coursebook 83-betdagi
maqolada eslatilgan klub.

items.sentence: 6  Living in the country is cheaper ........ living in the city.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'cheapER' — QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
DIQQAT: ikki tomonda ham 'LIVING' —
bir xil narsalar solishtiriladi.
'the country' = qishloq (shahardan tashqari).

items.sentence: 7  Death Valley is the hottest place ........ the world.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'the hottEST' — ORTTIRMA daraja,
'the world' — JOY → IN.
Coursebook 85-bet, 12-mashqning 6-bandi
ham aynan shu fakt.

'noisy' — ODDIY shakl va 'not' bor →
AS ... AS.
'Oxford is NOT AS NOISY AS Paris'
= Oksford Parij chalik shovqinli emas.
3-band bilan bir xil qoida.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the adjectives in brackets into the correct form.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N BAND. Har birida gapdagi KALIT SO'ZGA
qarab daraja tanlanadi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  MORE EXPENSIVE than    (than bor → qiyosiy)
   2  MORE CROWDED than      (than bor → qiyosiy)
   3  isn't as HIGH as       (as...as → oddiy shakl)
   4  THE OLDEST city        (the ... in → orttirma)
   5  THE LARGEST desert     (the ... in → orttirma)
   6  CHEAPER than           (than bor → qiyosiy)
   7  THE TALLEST building   (the ... in → orttirma)
   8  MORE POLLUTED than     (than bor → qiyosiy)
   9  THE BEST restaurant    (the ... in → orttirma)
  10  SMALLER than           (than bor → qiyosiy)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  Bu do'konlar qishloqdagilardan qimmatroq.
   2  Bu shahar besh yil oldingidan gavjumroq.
   3  Makkinli tog'i Everest chalik baland emas.
   4  Afina Yevropadagi eng eski shaharmi?
   5  Sahroi Kabir dunyodagi eng katta cho'l.
   6  Edinburg Parijdan arzonroq.
   7  Dunyodagi eng baland bino qaysi?
   8  Los-Anjeles Stratforddan ifloslanganroq.
   9  'The Willow's' — mening mahallamdagi eng
      yaxshi restoran.
  10  Bizning yangi mashinamiz eskisidan kichikroq.


ENG MUHIM BANDLAR:

  3-BAND ALDAMChI:
     'isn't AS ...... AS Mount Everest'
     'as ... as' orasiga ODDIY shakl:
        AS HIGH AS  ✓
        as higher as  ✗
     Mashq 'to'g'ri shaklga qo'ying' desa ham,
     bu yerda sifat O'ZGARMAYDI.

  9-BAND NOTO'G'RI SIFAT:
     'good' → 'the BEST' ('the goodest' XATO).

  2-BANDDAGI TAQQOSLASh:
     'more crowded THAN IT WAS five years ago'
     Shahar O'ZINING beshinchi yil oldingi holati
     bilan solishtirilmoqda.

  7-BAND 'TALL' — 'HIGH' EMAS:
     BINO uchun 'tall' ishlatiladi.
     3-bandda esa TOG' uchun 'high'.
     Kitob ikkalasini bir mashqda ataylab bergan.

items.textEn: 1  These shops are ............ (expensive) than the ones in the country.
items.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'expensive' — 3 bo'g'in → MORE EXPENSIVE.
'the ones' = 'the shops' o'rniga.

items.textEn: 2  This city is ............ (crowded) than it was five years ago.
items.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'crowded' — 2 bo'g'in, '-y' yo'q → MORE CROWDED.
Shahar O'ZINING besh yil oldingi holati bilan
solishtirilmoqda.

items.textEn: 3  Mount McKinley isn't as ............ (high) as Mount Everest.
items.whyUz:
ODDIY ShAKL — 'as ... as' orasiga sifat
O'ZGARMASDAN qo'yiladi.
'as HIGH as' ✓ / 'as higher as' ✗
TOG' uchun 'high' (bino uchun 'tall').
Makkinli (6190 m) Everestdan (8848 m) past —
Coursebook 85-bet, 12-mashqdan.

'... IN Europe' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'old' — 1 bo'g'in → THE OLDEST.
'THE' TUSHIB QOLMASIN.
Afina — Yunoniston poytaxti.

items.textEn: 5  The Sahara is ............ (large) desert in the world.
items.whyUz:
'... IN the world' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'large' — '-e' bilan tugagan → THE LARGEST.
Coursebook 85-bet, 12-mashqning 1-bandi
ham aynan shu fakt.

'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'cheap' — 1 bo'g'in → CHEAPER.
Coursebook 85-bet, 11-mashqda Edinburg
Londondan arzonroq edi.

items.textEn: 7  Which is ............ (tall) building in the world?
items.whyUz:
'... IN the world' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'tall' — 1 bo'g'in → THE TALLEST.
DIQQAT: BINO uchun 'tall'
(3-bandda TOG' uchun 'high' edi).

'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'polluted' — 3 bo'g'in → MORE POLLUTED.
Coursebook 82-betdagi 2-mashqda ham
aynan shu gap bor edi.

items.textEn: 9  The Willow's is ............ (good) restaurant in my neighbourhood.
items.whyUz:
'... IN my neighbourhood' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'good' — NOTO'G'RI sifat → THE BEST.
'the goodest' XATO.
'a neighbourhood' = mahalla.

items.textEn: 10  Our new car is ............ (small) than our old one.
items.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'small' — 1 bo'g'in → SMALLER.
'our old ONE' = 'our old car' o'rniga.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the adjectives in brackets into the correct form, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi sifatlarni namunadagidek to'g'ri shaklga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDA UCh HAYVON:
  FIL (the elephant)      — eng katta, eng og'ir
  SHER (the lion)         — eng xavfli, eng tez
  ShIMPANZE (the chimpanzee) — eng kichik, eng do'stona


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  The chimpanzee is NOT AS BIG AS (big) the
     elephant.

  Namuna MUHIM narsani ko'rsatadi: javobga
  'as' va 'as' ning IKKALASI ham kiradi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  is not AS BIG AS the elephant        (NAMUNA)
  2  The lion is SMALLER THAN the elephant.
  3  The lion is not AS FRIENDLY AS the chimpanzee.
  4  The elephant is THE HEAVIEST animal of all.
  5  The lion is THE MOST DANGEROUS animal of all.
  6  The chimpanzee is not AS FAST AS the lion.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Shimpanze fil chalik katta emas.
  2  Sher fildan kichikroq.
  3  Sher shimpanze chalik do'stona emas.
  4  Fil hamma hayvonlardan eng og'iri.
  5  Sher hamma hayvonlardan eng xavflisi.
  6  Shimpanze sher chalik tez emas.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — UCh XIL QOLIP:

  'is NOT ...... [ot]' → AS ... AS
     (1, 3, 6-bandlar)
     Bo'shliqdan keyin BIRDAN ot kelsa va 'not'
     bo'lsa — 'as ... as' kerak.

  'is ...... [ot]' (not YO'Q) → QIYOSIY + THAN
     (2-band)
     'The lion is ...... the elephant' —
     'than' ham bo'shliqqa kiradi:
     'SMALLER THAN'.

  'is ...... animal OF ALL' → ORTTIRMA
     (4, 5-bandlar)
     'of all' — ORTTIRMA darajaning belgisi.


SIFATLARNING YASALIShI:
  big       → as BIG as      (oddiy shakl)
  small     → SMALLER than   (1 bo'g'in → -ER)
  friendly  → as FRIENDLY as (oddiy shakl)
  heavy     → THE HEAVIEST   ('-y' → -IEST)
  dangerous → THE MOST DANGEROUS (3 bo'g'in)
  fast      → as FAST as     (oddiy shakl)


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDA 'THAN' HAM KERAK:
  'The lion is ...... (small) the elephant.'
  Gapda 'than' BOSILMAGAN — u ham bo'shliqqa
  kiradi: 'SMALLER THAN'.
  Bu — namunadagi 'as big as' bilan bir xil
  mantiq (u yerda ham ikkala 'as' javobga kirgan).

items.textEn: 1  The chimpanzee is not ............ (big) the elephant.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA. 'not' bor va bo'shliqdan keyin
birdan ot → AS ... AS.
'big' ODDIY shaklda qoladi.
Javobga IKKALA 'as' ham kiradi.

'not' YO'Q → QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
'small' — 1 bo'g'in → SMALLER.
DIQQAT: 'than' ham bo'shliqqa kiradi
(gapda bosilmagan).
Sher fildan kichikroq — rasmda ko'rinib turibdi.

items.textEn: 3  The lion is not ............ (friendly) the chimpanzee.
items.whyUz:
'not' bor → AS ... AS.
'friendly' ODDIY shaklda qoladi
('friendlier' XATO).
DIQQAT: 'friendly' '-ly' bilan tugasa ham
SIFAT (ravish emas).

items.textEn: 4  The elephant is ............ (heavy) animal of all.
items.whyUz:
'OF ALL' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'heavy' — '-y' bilan tugagan → THE HEAVIEST.
Fil — quruqlikdagi eng og'ir hayvon.

items.textEn: 5  The lion is ............ (dangerous) animal of all.
items.whyUz:
'OF ALL' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'dangerous' — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST DANGEROUS.
'dangerousest' XATO.

items.textEn: 6  The chimpanzee is not ............ (fast) the lion.
items.whyUz:
'not' bor → AS ... AS.
'fast' ODDIY shaklda qoladi.
Sher shimpanzedan tezroq yuguradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the adjectives in brackets into the correct form. Fill in than, of, in or the where necessary, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi sifatlarni to'g'ri shaklga qo'ying. Zarur bo'lganda than, of, in yoki the ni ham qo'shing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N YETTI BAND — mashqning eng katta qismi.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  My father is OLDER THAN my mother. (old)
  Javobga sifat ham, 'than' ham kiradi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  older than           (NAMUNA)
   2  noisy                ('very' dan keyin — ODDIY)
   3  more ... than
   4  the fastest ... of
   5  expensive            ('very' dan keyin — ODDIY)
   6  the best             (noto'g'ri sifat)
   7  the driest ... in
   8  bigger than
   9  famous               ('very' dan keyin — ODDIY)
  10  the tallest ... of
  11  the largest ... in
  12  prettier than
  13  more dangerous than
  14  safer ... than
  15  more crowded than
  16  tall                 ('quite' dan keyin — ODDIY)
  17  the kindest


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  Otam onamdan katta.
   2  Bu shahar juda shovqinli.
   3  Uning opasidan ko'proq o'yinchog'i bor.
   4  Gepard hamma hayvonlardan eng tezi.
   5  U ko'ylak juda qimmat.
   6  Bu hammasidan eng yaxshi film edi.
   7  Chili dunyodagi eng quruq joy.
   8  Uning kvartirasi bizникidan kattaroq.
   9  Tom Kruz juda mashhur.
  10  Jirafa hamma hayvonlardan eng balandi.
  11  AQShdagi eng katta shahar qaysi?
  12  Mishel Jenniferdan chiroyliroq.
  13  Mototsikllar samolyotlardan xavfliroq.
  14  Sizning pulingiz bankda uydagidan xavfsizroq.
  15  Plyaj o'tgan yilgidan gavjumroq.
  16  Jo ancha baland bo'yli.
  17  Opam men biladigan eng mehribon odam.


ENG MUHIM DARS — 'VERY' va 'QUITE' DAN KEYIN
SIFAT O'ZGARMAYDI:

  2-band:  'This city is VERY ...... .'   → NOISY
  5-band:  'That dress is VERY ...... .'  → EXPENSIVE
  9-band:  'Tom Cruise is VERY ...... .'  → FAMOUS
  16-band: 'Joe is QUITE ...... .'        → TALL

  Bu to'rt bandda QIYOSLASh YO'Q — shunchaki
  daraja ko'rsatilyapti.
  Grammar 52-betdagi 'Quite/Very/Too' qoidasi:
  'quite/very/too' + ODDIY sifat.

  Ular gapning OXIRIDA nuqta bilan tugaydi —
  bu ham ip: solishtiriladigan narsa YO'Q.


QANDAY ANIQLASh — TO'RT BELGI:

  'very' / 'quite' bor      →  ODDIY shakl
                               (2, 5, 9, 16)
  gapdan keyin ikkinchi narsa →  QIYOSIY + THAN
                               (1, 3, 8, 12, 13,
                                14, 15)
  'of all' bor              →  THE ... OF
                               (4, 10)
  'in the world/the USA' bor →  THE ... IN
                               (7, 11)
  'of all' yoki 'I know' bor →  THE ...
                               (6, 17)


ALOHIDA IZOHLAR:

  3-BAND: 'She has got ...... TOYS ...... her sister.'
     'many' → 'MORE' (noto'g'ri sifat) + THAN.
     'toys' — SANALADIGAN ot → 'many' to'g'ri edi.

  6-BAND: 'That was ...... film OF ALL.'
     'good' → 'THE BEST' (noto'g'ri sifat).
     'of all' bor, lekin javobda faqat 'the best' —
     'of all' gapda ALLAQAChON bor.

  7-BAND: 'Chile is ...... place ...... the world.'
     'dry' → '-y' tushadi → THE DRIEST + IN.
     Coursebook 85-bet, 12-mashqning 4-bandi
     ham aynan shu fakt (Atakama cho'li).

  14-BAND: 'Your money is ...... IN THE BANK ......
     it is AT HOME.'
     'safe' → '-e' → SAFER + THAN.
     Bankdagi pul uydagidan xavfsizroq.

  17-BAND: 'My sister is ...... person I KNOW.'
     'I know' — guruhni chegaralaydi
     (men biladigan odamlar orasida) → ORTTIRMA.
     'kind' → THE KINDEST.


SIFATLARNING YASALIShI:
  old       → oldER          (1 bo'g'in)
  many      → MORE           (noto'g'ri)
  fast      → the fastEST    (1 bo'g'in)
  good      → the BEST       (noto'g'ri)
  dry       → the drIEST     ('-y' → -IEST)
  big       → bigGER         (undosh ikkilanadi)
  tall      → the tallEST    (1 bo'g'in)
  large     → the largEST    ('-e' → faqat -ST)
  pretty    → prettIER       ('-y' → -IER)
  dangerous → MORE dangerous (3 bo'g'in)
  safe      → safER          ('-e' → faqat -R)
  crowded   → MORE crowded   (2 bo'g'in, '-y' yo'q)
  kind      → the kindEST    (1 bo'g'in)

items.whyUz:
NAMUNA. Ikki odam solishtirilmoqda →
QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
'old' — 1 bo'g'in → OLDER.

ODDIY ShAKL.
'very' + ODDIY sifat (Grammar 52-bet qoidasi).
QIYOSLASH YO'Q — gap nuqta bilan tugaydi.
'very noisier' XATO.

items.textEn: 3  She has got ............ toys ............ her sister.  (many)
items.whyUz:
'many' — NOTO'G'RI sifat → MORE + THAN.
'toys' — SANALADIGAN ot, shuning uchun 'many'
('much' emas).
Qiyosiy shakli ikkalasi uchun ham 'more'.

'all' — GURUH → ORTTIRMA daraja + OF.
'fast' — 1 bo'g'in → THE FASTEST ... OF all.
'a cheetah' = gepard — yer yuzidagi
eng tez hayvon (110 km/soat).

ODDIY ShAKL.
'very' + ODDIY sifat.
'very more expensive' XATO.
2-band bilan bir xil qoida.

'of all' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'good' — NOTO'G'RI sifat → THE BEST.
'the goodest' / 'the most good' XATO.
DIQQAT: 'of all' gapda ALLAQACHON bor —
javobga faqat 'the best' kiradi.

'the world' — JOY → ORTTIRMA daraja + IN.
'dry' — '-y' tushadi → THE DRIEST.
'the dryest' XATO.
Coursebook 85-bet, 12-mashqning 4-bandi
ham shu fakt (Atakama cho'li, Chili).

Ikki kvartira solishtirilmoqda →
QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
'big' — undosh + unli + undosh → 'g' IKKILANADI
→ BIGGER.
'ours' = 'our flat' o'rniga (egalik olmoshi).

ODDIY ShAKL.
'very' + ODDIY sifat.
'very more famous' XATO.
Tom Kruz — amerikalik aktyor.

'all' — GURUH → ORTTIRMA daraja + OF.
'tall' — 1 bo'g'in → THE TALLEST ... OF all.
Grammar 52-betdagi 'Use' qutisidagi namuna
ning aynan o'zi.

'the USA' — JOY → ORTTIRMA daraja + IN.
'large' — '-e' bilan tugagan → THE LARGEST.
Coursebook 83-betdagi maqola: 'Los Angeles is
the second LARGEST city in America.'

Ikki odam solishtirilmoqda →
QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
'pretty' — '-y' tushadi → PRETTIER.
'more pretty' ham uchraydi, lekin kitob
qoidasi bo'yicha PRETTIER.

QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
'dangerous' — 3 bo'g'in → MORE DANGEROUS.
'a motorcycle' = mototsikl,
'an aeroplane' = samolyot (Britaniya varianti;
Amerikada 'airplane').

items.textEn: 14  Your money is ............ in the bank ............ it is at home.  (safe)
items.whyUz:
IKKI joy solishtirilmoqda (bank ↔ uy) →
QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
'safe' — '-e' bilan tugagan → SAFER.
'safeer' XATO.
'AT home' — predlog AT.

items.textEn: 15  The beach is ............ it was last year.  (crowded)
items.whyUz:
Plyaj O'ZINING o'tgan yilgi holati bilan
solishtirilmoqda → QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
'crowded' — 2 bo'g'in, '-y' yo'q → MORE CROWDED.
3-mashqning 2-bandi bilan bir xil tuzilish.

ODDIY ShAKL.
'quite' + ODDIY sifat (Grammar 52-bet qoidasi).
'quite taller' XATO.
'quite tall' = ancha baland bo'yli.
2, 5, 9-bandlar bilan bir xil qoida.

items.textEn: 17  My sister is ............ person I know.  (kind)
items.whyUz:
'person I KNOW' — guruh chegaralangan
(men biladigan odamlar orasida) →
ORTTIRMA daraja.
'kind' — 1 bo'g'in → THE KINDEST.
'kind' = mehribon.

patterns.exampleEn: The Amazon River is longer than the Mississippi. My father is older than my mother.
patterns.exampleUz: Amazonka daryosi Missisipidan uzunroq. Otam onamdan katta.
patterns.explanationUz:
Gapda ikkinchi narsa bo'lsa va 'not as ... as'
ishlatilmagan bo'lsa — QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.

patterns.formula: A is THE [ORTTIRMA] [ot] OF all / IN [joy].
patterns.exampleEn: The giraffe is the tallest animal of all. Chile is the driest place in the world.
patterns.exampleUz: Jirafa hamma hayvonlardan eng balandi. Chili dunyodagi eng quruq joy.
patterns.explanationUz:
'of all' → OF (guruh)
'in the world / in the USA' → IN (joy)
DOIM 'THE' bilan.

patterns.formula: A is NOT AS [ODDIY sifat] AS B.
patterns.exampleEn: New York is not as clean as Stratford. The chimpanzee is not as big as the elephant.
patterns.exampleUz: Nyu-York Stratford chalik toza emas. Shimpanze fil chalik katta emas.
patterns.explanationUz:
'as' va 'as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli.
Javobga IKKALA 'as' ham kiradi.

patterns.exampleEn: This city is very noisy. Joe is quite tall.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu shahar juda shovqinli. Jo ancha baland bo'yli.
patterns.explanationUz:
QIYOSLASH YO'Q — sifat O'ZGARMAYDI.
'very noisier' / 'quite taller' XATO.
5-mashqning 2, 5, 9, 16-bandlari.

patterns.formula: A has got MORE [ot] THAN B.
patterns.exampleEn: She has got more toys than her sister.
patterns.explanationUz:
'many' / 'much' → MORE (noto'g'ri sifat).
Sanaladigan ot bilan 'many',
sanalmaydigan ot bilan 'much'.
